card.name: Space before a number in web text
card.fires_on: The space token right before a number, such as a count, percentage, year or date, in general web text about companies, emissions or history. It also fires on a few linking words such as "as" in "such as" before product names.

modes.label: Space before figures
modes.description: A bare space token just ahead of a quantity or percent in news or history prose.

modes.label: Space before years or dates
modes.description: A space token ahead of a year, citation number or day of the month.

modes.label: Linking word before product names
modes.description: The word "as" in "such as" or a name part inside a product list.
modes.example: The emergence of smartphones, such<< as>> BlackBerrys and Palm Pilots

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mixed political and symbol terms, so there is no clear output effect beyond a weak push away from words such as "targeting" and "typically".
card.plain: It lights up on the blank gap just before a number in ordinary web text, such as a percent, year or count.
